description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the multi-organ segmentation operation SegmentOAR
description_zh: 本文介绍多器官分割SegmentOAR的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess segment-oar --url-list URL=https://viapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/test/xxx/c001.dcm --data-format NIFTI --org-id 7ff51bfe-e73d-11ea-827d-506b4b3f3cf6 --org-name '测试组织' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SegmentOAR

fields.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1, URLList.2.URL=url2, and so on. Separate parameter pairs with ampersands (&). Replace url1, url2, and other values with actual values. When you use an SDK, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK to populate URLList
fields.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url

parameters.help_en: The format of the image. Only the following two formats are supported: DICOM and NIFTI
parameters.help_zh: 图像的格式。目前只支持以下两种：DICOM、NIFTI
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en: The code of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source organization
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the CT is contrast-enhanced.

true: contrast-enhanced CT
false: non-contrast CT
parameters.help_zh:
是否增强CT。

true：增强CT
false：平扫CT
parameters.name: contrast

parameters.help_en: The long integer array that specifies the organs to output
parameters.help_zh: 长整形数组，对应的器官输出
parameters.name: mask_list

parameters.help_en:
The body part that contains the organs at risk to output.

CHEST: chest
HEAD&NECK: head and neck.
Empty: the algorithm automatically detects the body part
parameters.help_zh:
期望输出的危及器官所在的身体部位。

CHEST：胸部
HEAD&NECK：头颈部。
空字段：算法自动检测
parameters.name: body_part
